title: Widget renders twice on sites with both a page template and global footer snippet
workaround: Remove the installation snippet from the page-specific template and keep only the copy in the shared global footer.

title: Typing indicator intermittently fails to display under degraded network conditions
workaround: Refresh the page to reestablish a clean real-time connection; message delivery itself is unaffected.

title: Pre-chat form field mapping breaks when a custom field is renamed rather than recreated
workaround: Create a new custom field for structural changes instead of renaming an existing field in place.

title: Proactive chat trigger can fire twice on pages with a delayed secondary content load
workaround: Disable proactive triggers on pages using deferred or lazy-loaded content blocks until a fix ships.

title: Multi-language widget falls back to default language for regional locale variants (e.g. en-GB, es-MX)
workaround: Set the page's html lang attribute to the base language code (e.g. "es" instead of "es-MX").

title: Mobile SDK push notification delivery delayed on select Android 14 devices
workaround: Exempt the host app from battery optimization in device settings until the underlying delivery fix ships.

title: Canned response placeholder renders literal tag text when the underlying field is empty
workaround: Configure a fallback default value on the placeholder under canned response settings.

title: Widget CSP verification tool reports false failure when tested from a browser with ad-blocking extensions
workaround: Run installation verification from a clean browser profile without ad-blocking or privacy extensions enabled.

title: SLA countdown recalculates from priority-change time rather than original creation time
workaround: Cross-check the ticket's audit history for a priority change before assuming an SLA breach reading is inaccurate.

title: Split ticket action does not duplicate original message attachments across both resulting tickets
workaround: Manually re-attach the relevant file to the second resulting ticket if it applies to both.

title: Bulk action confirmation count occasionally lags behind the actual filtered selection size
workaround: Manually re-verify the applied filter before confirming a bulk action on a large selection.

title: Email threading reference header dropped by a small number of legacy email clients
workaround: Include a visible ticket reference number in outbound templates as a threading fallback, then merge manually if needed.

title: Custom field validation error message does not clearly indicate the specific failing rule
workaround: Review the field's configured validation rule directly under Workflow > Fields rather than relying on the inline error text.

title: Automation rule referencing a deleted field silently stops running instead of surfacing a configuration warning
workaround: Search active automation rules for references before deleting any field, tag, or macro.

title: Duplicate tag entries created when tag creation is not restricted to administrators
workaround: Restrict tag creation permission to administrators and periodically consolidate near-duplicate tags.

title: Bulk import rejects rows with valid data when column headers use extra whitespace
workaround: Download a fresh copy of the current import template and avoid manually editing header cells.

title: Custom dashboard widget cache not invalidated immediately after a referenced tag is renamed
workaround: Edit and resave the affected widget's filter to force a cache refresh after renaming a referenced tag.

title: Scheduled PDF export clips wide dashboard widgets rather than reflowing them
workaround: Use narrower widget layouts for dashboards intended for PDF scheduled delivery, or export as CSV instead.

title: Real-time dashboard occasionally displays a transient queue count mismatch during high-volume bursts
workaround: Refresh the dashboard; the underlying case data is accurate and the discrepancy self-resolves within minutes.

title: Team performance benchmark widget includes deactivated agents in historical comparison by default
workaround: Apply the "active agents only" filter on the team performance widget for forward-looking comparisons.

title: CSAT trend line does not visually flag a mid-period survey scale change
workaround: Cross-reference the Audit Log for survey configuration changes before interpreting a sharp trend shift.

title: Data warehouse export occasionally omits the final batch of records when a run is manually cancelled and restarted
workaround: Avoid manually cancelling an in-progress export run; allow it to complete or fail naturally before retrying.

title: Threshold alert evaluation interval can miss brief metric spikes that resolve between checks
workaround: Shorten the alert's evaluation interval for metrics known to fluctuate quickly, where available on your plan.

title: Offset-based pagination can return duplicate records when underlying data changes mid-iteration
workaround: Use cursor-based pagination instead of offset-based pagination for any actively changing data set.

title: Webhook retry can redeliver an event even after the receiving endpoint has acknowledged it, under specific timeout conditions
workaround: Design webhook consumers to be idempotent using the event's unique ID, regardless of acknowledgment timing.

title: Rate limit response headers occasionally omit Retry-After under sustained high load
workaround: Fall back to a fixed exponential backoff schedule when the Retry-After header is not present in a 429 response.

title: Sandbox environment reset does not clear webhook delivery history from the prior test cycle
workaround: Manually disregard delivery history timestamps predating the most recent sandbox reset.

title: Bulk update endpoint's per-record error array is inconsistently ordered relative to the submitted batch
workaround: Match per-record results by the record's returned ID field rather than assuming array order.

title: Documentation portal search occasionally fails to index a newly published endpoint for up to 24 hours
workaround: Browse the relevant category directly from the table of contents rather than relying solely on search for very recently published endpoints.

title: Custom field identifier lookup endpoint returns stale results for up to a few minutes after field creation
workaround: Allow a brief delay after creating a custom field before relying on it via the API.

title: App crashes on launch after update on devices running the minimum supported OS version
workaround: Clear the app's local cache/storage through device settings, or uninstall and reinstall the current version.

title: Offline draft occasionally lost when a major app version update is installed before reconnecting
workaround: Send or discard pending offline drafts before initiating an app update; avoid updating while offline with unsent replies.

title: Revoked device session can briefly reappear as active due to a cached refresh token timing edge case
workaround: Revoke the session a second time to ensure full invalidation if it reappears as active.

title: Dark mode theming incomplete on the escalation approval screen
workaround: Cosmetic only; no functional impact. No workaround needed.

title: Tablet layout does not consistently trigger in certain third-party split-screen multitasking configurations
workaround: Exit split-screen mode or rotate the device to allow the app to detect sufficient screen space.

title: Badge count on the app icon can drift from the true unread count under high notification volume
workaround: Treat the badge count as a general indicator; open the app for the accurate, current count.

title: MDM managed app configuration payload silently ignored if a key name does not match schema casing exactly
workaround: Validate the managed app configuration payload against the exact schema casing in the developer documentation before deployment.

title: Clipboard paste into the reply composer occasionally requires two attempts on newly enrolled devices
workaround: Grant clipboard access when prompted; if no prompt appears, check clipboard permission under device privacy settings.
